{{Youmay|the spaceport|[[Pavillion]], an underwater city on Iskalon}}
'''Pavilion port''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], known for its role in the [[Slavery/Legends|slave trade]]. [[Elis Helrot/Legends|Elis Helrot]] made regular slaving runs to Pavilion port.<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Pavilion port was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
